necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising clinical concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias associated with diagnosis code I49.9. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate these symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period. This diagnostic procedure is essential for accurate diagnosis and management of the patient's unstable cardiac condition.
